title: Learning with Bilevel-Minimax Optimization for Efficient and Reliable Transfer Attacks
abstract: arXiv:2608.11815v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transfer-based adversarial attacks craft adversarial examples using surrogate models to mislead black-box victim models. Beyond perturbation generation, transferability is fundamentally governed by the coupling of initialization, surrogate adaptation, and gradient dynamics. We revisit this challenge from a bilevel-minimax perspective and propose BMAT (Bilevel-Minimax Adversarial Transfer). The bilevel formulation captures the dependency between initialization and perturbation, while the inner minimax problem promotes surrogate robustness for cross-architecture generalization. Algorithmically, we develop an integrated bottom-up solver that combines a Soft Weight Modulator and an Implicit Gradient Approximator to enable ternary coupling among initialization, surrogate adaptation, and perturbation optimization. translated_title: 基于双层-极小极大优化的高效可靠迁移攻击学习
translated_abstract: 基于迁移的对抗攻击利用替代模型生成对抗样本，以误导黑盒受害模型。除了扰动生成之外，迁移性从根本上由初始化、替代模型适应和梯度动态的耦合所决定。我们从双层-极小极大的视角重新审视这一挑战，并提出BMAT（双层-极小极大对抗迁移）。双层公式捕捉了初始化与扰动之间的依赖关系，而内层极小极大问题则促进替代模型的鲁棒性以实现跨架构泛化。在算法上，我们开发了一种集成的自底向上求解器，结合了软权重调制器和隐式梯度逼近器，以实现初始化、替代模型适应和扰动优化之间的三元耦合。我们进一步提供了所提出的双层-极小极大框架优化动态的理论见解。大量实验表明...
tldr: 本文提出BMAT框架，通过双层-极小极大优化耦合初始化、替代模型适应和扰动，实现高效可靠的迁移攻击。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the BMAT framework, which couples initialization, surrogate adaptation, and perturbation via bilevel-minimax optimization for efficient and reliable transfer attacks.
